high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "rvcjinsta." The post features a headline about the potential increase in the cost of Hyderabadi Biryani due to the Taliban's return in Afghanistan. The text explains that the Taliban has stopped the movement of cargo through transit routes in Pakistan, leading to a spike in the prices of dry fruits sold in India. It also mentions that India imports around 85 percent of its dry fruits from Afghanistan. The post includes a photograph of a plate of Hyderabadi Biryani, garnished with herbs and served on a black plate. A fork
